as of 2026-08-30  |  first hike assumed: 2026-07-13 (-48 days from today)
Caveats for KRW
  • 4 historical cycles -- still a thin sample, treat the signal column as low-conviction.
  • Oct-05 has no pre-hike 10Y NDIRS data, so the similarity engine can't truly match today against 2005 -- it gets a fallback weight. Move data still contributes to history.
  • Aug-21 (post-COVID, +300bp to a 3.50% terminal) was a stop-start cycle -- hikes Aug & Nov 2021, a pause, then rapid tightening through 2022. Anchored at the 26-Aug-2021 first hike, so the window spans the early pause; trust 'vs avg move' over level-based reads for this cycle.
  • Several forward-spread endpoint z-scores are large (|z_ep|>5) because the cycles ended up tightly clustered at +3M; trust the 'vs avg move' column over 'vs avg level' for those trades.
